verdict.rationale: Phaser ships full TypeScript type definitions that modern editors like VSCode auto-detect, enabling completions and navigation for AI coding agents (phaser-docs-4, phaser-docs-33, phaser-gh-1). However there is no dedicated language server, and community commentary notes the TypeScript experience was historically a 'best-effort' layer via DefinitelyTyped rather than a native, fully polished typed API, with Phaser 4's native-TS rewrite reportedly stalled (phaser-comm-8), and early users cited missing/incomplete TS defs as a pain point (phaser-comm-1). Missing for 10: an official LSP, first-party (non-DefinitelyTyped) native TypeScript authoring, and independent confirmation that current type defs are complete/high-quality for agent tooling.
